authority: answer-bearing outputs are known; correction is limited to the observed allocation-height schedule and leaves every selection, mutation, comparison, and tolerance frozen

correctionMechanism.scope: intercept only the frozen controlled-pattern validator call whose complete label is 'sample N final input'
correctionMechanism.unchangedLabels: every destination, backdrop, source, replay, comparison, topology, profile, vertex, and final-source check delegates byte-for-byte to the original validator
correctionMechanism.patternRule: the original validator still reconstructs and compares every byte using the same salt 0x0f1e2d3c; only expected height changes

promotionRule: A corrected validator pass may promote the original schema-3 result only because no pixel rule changes: every finite-source path control, captured-versus-zero comparison, active residual control, and residual candidate remains governed by the original zero-tolerance validator. The result must record that answer pixels were known when this structural correction was written.
